evidence.reason: The test still initializes the stale manifest with a digest ("2"*64) that differs from the downloaded bytes b"unexpected", while the refreshed manifest uses a different digest ("3"*64). Thus both the correct refresh path and a buggy path that skips the refresh verify against a mismatching checksum and raise ValueError, so the test passes without proving the refreshed manifest was used. Setting the stale digest to vm.sha256_bytes(b"unexpected") and keeping the refreshed digest different would make the buggy stale-checksum path succeed and fail this test. This is a routine test-correctness repair, not a new requirement or behavior change.
